# Supabase JavaScript Library

Copied from npm so the app does not depend on a third-party CDN:

| File | Package | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `supabase.js` | `@supabase/supabase-js` (`dist/umd/supabase.js`) | 2.119.0 | MIT (`LICENSE-supabase-js.txt`) |

Used by `auth.js` (sign-in by email link, staying signed in) and `cloud-db.js`
(My Transcripts). It is given only the public publishable key.
